proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5599.2 *dhera explicitly gives Nepali dher/dherai much, many. Nepal-area dhere many matches this dental-initial branch with its final vowel retained. The promoted dental subsection is used rather than the retroflex heap family; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: dʰere.
